title: What's up with Sunday+Night?
abstract: Early Sunday+Night piece, three years after founding. Uses the Sunday-night dread of the coming work week as a metaphor for the gap between 'work you' and the rest of your life, and pitches Sunday+Night's premise — that the work week should 'feed your soul, not just your wallet' — as the antidote. Names Heidi Philip as 'Alchemist' at Sunday+Night alongside Diaz, giving the earliest confirmation of a second named person on the team.
